vo.en: Your best friend is just a coincidence.
vo.fr: Ton meilleur ami est une coïncidence.

visual.description: Two men walking and talking casually in a sunlit park.

vo.en: It isn't fate or some magical connection, it’s simply the Propinquity Effect.
vo.fr: Ce n'est pas le destin ou la magie, c'est simplement l'effet de proximité.

visual.description: A digital animation of a map with pins popping up close together.

vo.en: Famous research proves that physical distance is the single greatest predictor of your entire social circle.
vo.fr: La recherche prouve que la distance physique est le premier prédicteur de ton cercle social.

visual.description: A long, empty apartment hallway with many doors on both sides.

vo.en: In one landmark study, people living right next to the stairs had significantly more friends.
vo.fr: Une étude montre que vivre près des escaliers augmente radicalement tes chances d'amitié.

visual.description: A man in business casual attire walking up a flight of modern stairs.

vo.en: Every single time you pass someone, your brain subconsciously marks them as safe and familiar.
vo.fr: Chaque croisement habituel pousse ton cerveau à percevoir cette personne comme familière et sûre.

visual.description: A tight close-up of a man's eyes blinking and looking thoughtful.

vo.en: You didn’t actually choose a soulmate; you just chose the person living closest to your door.
vo.fr: Tu n'as pas trouvé une âme sœur, tu as juste trouvé ton voisin de palier.

visual.description: A man opening his apartment door and nodding to someone just out of frame.

vo.en: It is hard to accept that your deepest bonds are really just a result of geography.
vo.fr: C'est troublant de voir que tes liens dépendent presque entièrement de la géographie.

visual.description: An aerial drone view of a dense urban neighborhood and houses.
A blurred, fast-motion shot of many people walking on a city sidewalk.
